science-d001-j79: 科普进阶篇 the secrets of ice cream production science-d001-j79 the secrets of ice cream production. ice cream is the most popular treat on hot summer days. it is cold and smooth on the tongue when you lick it, and its sweet taste melts away instantly on your tongue. do you like eating ice cream? technically, ice cream is a complex frozen dessert. it is made from milk, fresh cream, sugar, and flavorings. it comes in rich colors and delicious tastes. while it helps people beat the summer heat, it is primarily loved for bringing joy to children and adults in hot weather. step 1. prepare the ice cream base. workers mix all raw materials evenly, filter out impurities, homogenize the mixture, and pasteurize it to kill bacteria. after cooling the mixture below 10 degrees celsius, add fruit flavorings and cool it further to 0–5 degrees celsius. step 2. aging. put the cooled base into cans and leave it to stand for several hours. this process greatly improves the smooth texture of ice cream. step 3. churning and freezing. churn the base continuously while freezing it. air is incorporated into the liquid mixture, turning it into soft, fluffy, semi-solid ice cream. step 4. packaging and hardening. quickly fill the cups with soft ice cream, then transfer them to a freezer at negative 40 degrees celsius for deep hardening! once fully solidified, the finished ice cream is ready. 冰淇淋制作的秘密。 在炎热的夏日，冰淇淋是最受欢迎的甜品。 当你舔它时，舌头会感到冰凉而光滑，而它那甜美的味道会在舌尖上瞬间融化。 你喜欢吃冰淇淋吗？ 从技术上讲，冰淇淋是一种复杂的冷冻甜点。 它是由牛奶、鲜奶油、糖和调味料制成的。 它色彩丰富，味道鲜美。 虽然它能帮助人们抵御夏日炎热，但人们主要还是喜欢它在炎热的天气里给儿童和成人带来欢乐。 第一步。 准备好冰淇淋底料。 工作人员将所有原材料均匀混合，过滤掉杂质，使混合物均匀化，并对其进行巴氏杀菌以杀死细菌。 将混合物冷却至10摄氏度以下后，加入水果调味料，再进一步冷却至0至5摄氏度。 第二步。 陈化。将冷却后的基底装入罐中，静置数小时。 这一过程大大提升了冰淇淋的口感顺滑度。 第三步。 翻腾和冻结。 在冷冻的过程中，要不断地搅拌基底。 空气被融入液体混合物中，使其变成柔软蓬松的半固体冰淇淋。 步骤4。 包装与硬化。 快往杯子里装满软冰淇淋，然后转移到零下40摄氏度的冰箱里进行深度硬化！ 一旦完全凝固，成品冰淇淋就做好了。

science-d008-dyd: 用英文讲好中国故事 national day – a celebration of our great country science-d008-dyd national day, a celebration of our great country. october 1st is a very special day for every chinese person. it is china's national day. on this day in 1949, the people's republic of china was founded. every year we celebrate this day with joy and pride. when we see the 5 -star red flag flying in the sky we feel proud. the flag is bright red, like a flame that lights up the land. the five stars on the flag shine together showing the unity of the chinese people. china is a country with a long history and a rich culture. it has beautiful mountains, long rivers, and many great cities. the chinese people are hardworking, brave, and kind. they love their country, and are always ready to help each other. national day reminds us of the hard work and sacrifice of those who came before us. they built our country and gave us a better life. it also reminds us to be grateful and to work hard for a brighter future. many people celebrate by traveling, spending time with family, or watching the flag raising ceremony. but no matter how we celebrate, we all share one thing love for our country. happy national day! may our country always be strong and prosperous. 国庆节，是我们伟大祖国的庆典。 10月1日对每一个中国人来说都是一个非常特殊的日子。 今天是中国的国庆节。 1949年的这一天，中华人民共和国成立了。 每年我们都满怀喜悦和自豪地庆祝这一天。 当我们看到五星红旗在天空中飘扬时，我们感到自豪。 这面旗帜鲜红如火，如同照亮大地的火焰。 国旗上的五颗星星共同闪耀，象征着中国人民的团结。 中国是一个历史悠久、文化丰富的国家。 它有美丽的山脉、悠长的河流和许多大城市。 中国人民勤劳、勇敢、善良。 他们热爱自己的国家，总是乐于互相帮助。 国庆节让我们想起那些前辈们的辛勤工作和牺牲。 他们建设了我们的国家，并为我们带来了更美好的生活。 它还提醒我们要心怀感激，并为更美好的未来而努力。 许多人通过旅行、与家人共度时光或观看升旗仪式来庆祝。 但无论我们如何庆祝，我们都共同拥有一个特质——对祖国的热爱。 国庆节快乐！ 愿我们的国家永远强大繁荣。

有时他们甚至演奏音乐! today, shadow puppetry is a unesco intangible cultural heritage. 今天,影子木偶是联合国教科文组织的非物质文化遗产。 many schools and museums teachit to children. 许多学校和博物馆都向儿童传授。 some artists use modern technology, like led lights and videos, to make it more exciting. 一些艺术家使用现代技术,如led灯和视频,使其更加刺激. this old art keeps shining in new ways. 这种古老的艺术以新的方式不断闪耀. 皮影戏是一种古老的中国讲故事艺术，已有两千多年的历史。传说汉武帝失去了心爱的妃子，非常思念她。 一位术士用灯光让她的影子在幕布上移动，皮影戏就这样诞生了。制作皮影时，艺人会选择兽皮，比如牛皮或羊皮。 他们把皮削薄，雕刻出精美的花纹，再涂上鲜艳的颜色，最后在四肢装上小棍。一个好皮影可能要花几周才能完成！ 表演时，艺人们站在白色幕布后面，把皮影贴近幕布，操纵小棍。明亮的灯光从后面照过来，观众就能看到彩色的影子。 艺人们还会为角色唱歌、说话，有时甚至演奏音乐！如今，皮影戏被列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录。 shadow/faedau/影子 puppetry/papitri/木偶戏 legend/led3and/传说 carve/ka:v/雕刻 pattern/'paetan/ 图案 screen/skri:n/幕布 audience/'o:dians/观众 heritage /'heritid3/遗产 ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇ , ⁇
re-d036-hr5: 用英文讲好中国故事 what was the three kingdoms period? re-d036-hr5 read and learn what was the three kingdoms s period? 阅读和学习 "三国演义"是什么?. the three kingdoms period is one of the most famous times in chinese history. 三國时期是中国历史上最著名的时期之一. it lasted from about the year 220 to 280, after the big han dynasty fell apart. 从220年左右一直延续到280年,在大汉朝灭亡后. china was split into three kingdoms: wei in the north, shu in the southwest, and wu in the 蜀 southeast. 中国分裂为三个王国:北方的魏国,西南的舒国,东南的吴国. this was a time of great wars, clever plans, and brave heroes. 当时是大战时期,有聪明的计划,有勇敢的英雄. the most well-known story is about the three sworn brothers: liu bei, guan yu, and zhang fei. 最知名的故事讲述了三个宣誓的兄弟:刘备,关羽,张飞. they promised to protect each other and bring peace to the land. 他们答应互相保护,给土地带来和平. liu bei was kind and caring, guan yu was brave and loyal, and zhang fei was strong and fearless. 刘备善待,关羽勇猛,忠心耿耿,张飞强壮,无所畏惧. together, they built the shu kingdom with the help of the brilliant advisor zhuge liang. 在辉煌的顾问诸葛亮的帮助下,他们共同建立了舒国. zhuge liang, also known as kongming, is one of the smartest people in chinese history. 诸葛亮,又称孔明,是中国历史上最聪明的人之一. he was a great strategistwho couldpredict theweather and outsmart his enemies. 他是一个伟大的战略家 他能够预测天气 并比他的敌人聪明。 stories say he once borrowed arrows from the enemy using straw boats and fog! 传说他曾经用稻草船和雾向敌人借箭! his loyalty to liu bei and shu kingdom is still admired today. 他对刘备和舒国忠心耿耿,今日仍受宠若惊. the three kingdoms story has been told for hundreds of years in books, operas, games, and tv shows. "三国演义"的故事在书,歌剧,游戏,电视剧中被讲述了数百年. the famous novel romance of the three kingdoms is one of china's four greatest classic books. "三国演义"的著名小说罗曼史是中国四大经典著作之一. people still talk about the heroes and their adventures. 人们仍然谈论英雄和他们的冒险. the stories teach us about friendship, wisdom, and never giving up. 故事教我们友谊,智慧,永不放弃.
sec_q9ggb3-d014-lzs: 用英文讲好中国故事 sun wukong – the monkey king sec_q9ggb3-d014-lzs read and learn wukong sun king themonkey sun wukong, also called the monkey king, comes from a famous chinese book called journey to the west. magical /'mad31kl/ 神奇的，魔法的 孙悟空，也叫美猴王，出自中国著名的小说《西游记》。 he was born from a magical stone on a mountain. 他是由山上的一块仙石 孕育而生的。 he is brave, clever, and sometimes very naughty. 他勇敢、聪明，有时也很调皮。 many chinese children grow up hearing his stories. 很多中国孩子都是听着他的故事长大 ·brave /brerv/ 勇敢的 的。 the monkey king has amazing powers. naughty /`no:ti/ 调皮的，淘气的 孙悟空拥有神奇的本领。 he can turn into 72 different forms, such as a bird, a tree, or even a tiny bug. 他会七十二变，可以变成鸟、树，甚至一只小虫子。 he can jump very far and ride on clouds. 他 能跳得很远，还会腾云驾雾。 he also pulls out hairs from his body and blows on them to make many small monkeys to help him fight. 他还能从身上拔下毫毛，吹一口气，变出许多小猴 power /`pauar/ 能力，力量 子来帮他战斗。 his most famous weapon is the golden staff (jingu bang). weapon /'wepan/ 武器 他最著名的武器是金箍棒。 it looks like an iron rod, but it can grow or shrink as he wishes. 它看起来像一根铁棍，但可以随心所欲地变大或变小。 at first, it was used to measure the depth of the sea, butsun wukong took it and made it his own. 最初，它是用来测量海水深度的，但孙悟空把它拿来当作了自己的武器。 with this staff, he protects his master tang monk during their journey to the west. 他用这根 shrink /frink/ 缩小 棒子保护师父唐僧西天取经。 today, sun wukong is known all over the world, his story has been made into movies, cartoons, and games. protect /pra'tekt/ 保护 如今，孙悟空在全世界都很有名。 he is a symbol of courage andfreedom, andpeople of all ageslove this clever hero. 他的故事被拍成了电影、动画片和游戏。 核心单词 他是 勇气和自由的象征，各个年龄段的人都喜欢这位聪明的英雄。 symbol /'simbl/ 象征
re-d015-w5b: 用英文讲好中国故事 chopstick culture re-d015-w5b read and learn chopstick culture chopsticks are one of the oldest eating tools in the world. 核心词汇 筷子是世界上最古老的进食工具之一，已有三千多年的历史。 they have a history of more than 3,000 years. 很久以前，古代中国人 chopsticks /'t{pp. strks/ n.筷子 用树枝从热锅中夹取食物。 long ago, ancient chinese people used sticks to pick up food from hot pots. 后来，筷子成为数亿人每天使用的工具。 later, chopsticks became a daily tool for millions of people. history /'his. tr:/ n.历史 大多数筷子由竹子或木头制成，也有一些是塑料、金属甚至象牙做的。 most chopsticks are made of bamboo or wood. 使用时，下面的 筷子保持不动，上面的筷子像小杠杆一样活动。 some are made of plastic, metal, or even ivory. 多加练习，你就能夹起米饭、面条， bamboo /baem'bu:/ n.竹子 甚至一颗碗豆！ to use them, hold the lower stick still and move the upper stick like a small lever. lever /'li:. var/ n.杠杆 筷子有很多礼仪规矩。 with practice, you can pick up rice, noodles, and even a single pea! 不要把筷子竖直插在米饭里一一这看起来像葬礼上的香。 chopsticks come with rules. 不要用 upright /sp. rat/ adj.竖直的 筷子指着别人，也不要用筷子敲碗。 never stick them upright in your rice——-this looks like incense at a funeral. 在中国、日本、韩国和越南，人们每天都用筷子， funeral /'fju. nar. al/ n.葬礼 但每个国家的筷子风格不同。 don't point at people with them, and never use them to hit a bowl. 比如，韩国筷子常常是金属的，而中国筷子更长。 in china, japan, korea, and vietnam, chopsticks are used every day, but each country has its own style. respect /ri'spekt/ n.尊重 学习筷子文化不只是学会吃饭，更是学会尊重、耐心和传统。 for example, korean chopsticks are often metal, while chinese ones are longer. 所以下次拿起筷子时， tradition /tra'dif. an/ n.传统 请记住：你手里握着的是一段历史。 learning chopstick culture is not just about eating——it is about respect, patience, and tradition. 学习筷子文化不仅仅是吃东西,而是尊重、耐心和传统。 so next time you pick up your chopsticks, remember: you are holding a piece of history. 所以下次你拿起筷子的时候,记住: 你握着一段历史。
re-d016-9t3: 用英文讲好中国故事 hot pot: a fun and tasty meal re-d016-9t3 read and learn hot pot: a fun and tasty meal hot pot is a very popular dish in china. 阅读与学习热点锅:一个趣味与美味的热点锅,是中国非常流行的菜肴. it has a long history of over one thousand years. 它有着超过一千年的悠久历史. people first ate hot pot in the cold north, and now it is loved all over the country. 人们首先在寒冷的北方吃热锅,现在全国各地都爱吃热锅. how do we eat hot pot? 我们怎么吃热锅? a pot of hot soup sits in the middle of the table. 一壶热汤坐中堂. people put raw meat, vegetables, mushrooms, and tofu into the boiling soup. 人们将生肉,蔬菜,蘑菇,豆腐放入沸汤中. after a few minutes, the food is cooked. 过几分钟,食物就煮熟了. then you take it out, dip it in sauce, and enjoy! 然后你把它拿出来, 浸在酱汁里,享受! there are many kinds of soup bases. 汤基有多种. some are spicy and red, with chili and oil. 有些是辣味和红色的,有辣椒和油. others are mild and white, made with bones or tomatoes. 另一些则温和而白色,用骨骼或番茄制作. if you can't decide, you can choose a "double-flavor pot" with both sides. 无法决定的,可以选择一个两侧的"双味锅"(double-flavor pot). that way, everyone is happy! 那样,大家都很开心! hot pot is also a social meal. 热锅也是社交餐. friends and family sit around the same pot, talking and laughing while cooking together. 朋友和家人坐在同一个锅旁,在一起做饭的时候会说话和大笑. it makes people feel warm and close. 能令众生发热近心. next time you eat hot pot, remember: it's not just a meal, it's a happy time together! 下一次吃热锅时,记住:这不仅仅是一顿饭,是在一起的快乐时光!
re-d016-837: 用英文讲好中国故事 hua mulan: a brave girl in chinese history re-d016-837 read and learn hua mulan: a brave girl in chinese history hua mulan is a famous girl in ancient china. 读学华木兰:中国历史中一个勇敢的女孩华木兰是中国古代著名的女孩. her storyhasbeentoldformorethan1,500years. 她的故事已经有超过1500年的历史了 mulan livedwithher oldfather, hermother, andher younger sister. 木兰和她的老爹,母亲,妹妹一起生活. one day, the emperor asked every family to send one man to fight in the war. 一日,帝请各家派一人参战. but mulan's father was too old and sick to go. 但木兰的父亲年老病重,不能去. mulan loved her father very much. 木兰非常爱她的父亲. she decided to take his place. 她决定接替他的位置. she cut her long hair, put on her father's armor, androde ahorse tojoin the army. 她剪了长发,穿上父亲的盔甲,骑着一匹马加入军队. for twelve years, she fought bravely in many battles. 十二年来,她在许多战役中英勇作战. no one knew she was a girl. 没有人知道她是个女孩。 she became a great warrior and helped her country win the war. 她成为一名伟大的战士,帮助她的国家赢得战争. when the war ended, mulan returned home. 战争结束后,木兰回国. her old friends were surprised to see her as a woman. 她的老朋友们惊讶地看到她是个女人. but they all respected her. 但他们都尊重她 mulan's story teaches us that courage and love for family are more important than being strong or being a boy. 木兰的故事教导我们,勇气和对家庭的爱比强壮或做男孩更重要. today, mulan is known all over the world. 今日木兰闻名于世. disney madeacartoonmovieaboutherin1998, and a live-actionmoviein2020. 迪士尼公司1998年时的"makeakartonnovie",以及2020年的现场动作电影. many childrenloveher because she is smart, brave, and kind. 许多孩子爱她,因为她聪明,勇敢,善良。
re-d018-ec4: 用英文讲好中国故事 tai chi: a moving meditation re-d018-ec4 read and learn tai chi: a moving meditation tai chi, also called taijiquan, is an ancient chinese martial art. 读习太极:一种感动的冥想太极,又称太极泉,是中国古代的武术. it started hundreds of years ago in china. 始于中国数百年前. people first practiced it for self-defense, but today many do it for health and relaxation. 人们首先为了自卫而练习,但今天很多人是为了健康和放松而练习. the most important idea in tai chi is yin and yang. 太极中最重要的思想是阴阳. yin and yang are two opposite forces thatbalance each other, like day and night, or soft and hard. 阴阳是两股相互平衡的对立力量,如昼夜,或柔软硬硬. in tai chi, you move slowly and smoothly in circles. 在太极中,你在圆圈中缓慢而顺利地移动. you breathe deeply and keep your body relaxed. 你深呼吸,让你的身体放松。 this helps your mind stay calm and focused. 这有助于你保持冷静和专注 tai chi is very good for your health. 太极对身体很好 it makes your muscles stronger and your balance better. 它让你的肌肉更坚固, 你的平衡更好。 it can also reduce stress and help you sleep well. 也可以减轻压力,帮助你安眠. because the movements are gentle, even old people and children can do it safely. 因为运动很温柔,即使是老人和儿童也能安全地完成. many schools in china teach tai chi to students during breaks. 中国多所学校在课间休息时向学生教授太极. today, tai chi is popular all over the world. 今太极流行于天下. people in parks in new york, london, and tokyo practice it every morning. 纽约,伦敦和东京的公园里的人每天早上都会练习. it is a beautiful way to exercise both the body and the mind. 锻炼身体和思想是种美妙的方式。 why not try it yourself? re-d029-bpd: 用英文讲好中国故事 chinese calligraphy re-d029-bpd read and learn chinese calligraphy chinese calligraphy is an ancient art of writing chinese characters with a brush. 读习中国书法 中国书法是古代用笔画中国人物的艺术. it has a history of more than three thousand years. 其历史年代为三千多年. in the past, people used calligraphy to write books, letters, and poems. 过去人们用书法写书,书信,诗. today, it is stillverypopularin china and around the world. 今天,它仍然是中国乃至世界各地的流行药物。 to practice calligraphy, you need four special tools 静致走 called thefour treasures of thestudy. 要练习书法,需要四个特殊的工具 qq,叫做"四宝"的"四宝". they are the brush made of animal hair, ink usually black, paper often ricepaper, and the inkstone used to grind the ink. 它们是动物毛的笔刷,墨水通常为黑色,纸张常为米纸,以及用来磨制墨水的墨石. with these tools, calligraphers create beautiful lines and shapes. 通过这些工具,书法家创造了美丽的线条和形状. each stroke must be done carefully, with theright speed and pressure. 每一次中风都要小心翼翼,以正确的速度和压力进行. calligraphy is not just writing, it is also a form of art. 书法不仅是写作,也是艺术的一种形式. a good piece of calligraphy can show the writer's feelings, personality, and evenmood. 一部优秀的书法作品可以展现作家的感情,个性,和均匀. somepeople compare it to painting ormusic, because it has rhythm and beauty. 有些人把它和绘画或音乐相比较,因为它有节奏和美感. in china, calligraphy is considered one of the highest forms of visual art. 在中国,书法被认为是视觉艺术的最高形式之一. learning calligraphy is good foreveryone, especially students. 学习书法对大家都有好处,尤其是学生. it helps you focus, be patient, and feel calm. 它能帮助你集中注意力,耐心, 并感到冷静。 it also helps you understand chinese culture better. 这也帮助你更好地理解中国文化. even if you are not chinese, you can enjoy the beauty of calligraphy, why not try it with a brush and ink today? 即使不是中国人,也可以享受书法的美,不如今天用笔刷和墨水来试一试?

re-d034-zd2: 用英文讲好中国故事 chinese porcelain — a treasure of the world re-d034-zd2 read and learn chinese porcelain a treasure of the world chinese porcelain is one of the greatest inventions in human history. ： 中国陶瓷是人类历史上最伟大的发明之一。 people in china began making pottery thousands of years ago, and by the tang and song dynasties, chinese porcelain had become famous all over the world. 中国人几千年前 就开始制作陶器，到了唐宋时期已经闻名世界，不仅美丽而 且坚固，能装水也能保温。 it was not only beautiful but also very strong, and it could hold water and heatwell. 景德镇被称为中国瓷都，一千多 年来制作出世界上最精美的瓷器，最著名的是青花瓷，白色 底上有漂亮的蓝色花纹。 the city of jingdezhen, in jiangxi province, is called the‘porcelain capital’of china. 中国陶瓷通过丝绸之路传到其他 国家，欧洲和中东的人们非常喜爱，把它叫做china。 for over a thousand years, skilled workers there made the finest porcelain in the world. 中国 陶瓷不仅是物品，更是艺术和历史，展示了中国人民的智慧 和创造力。 one of the most famous types is blue-and-white porcelain. 最著名的一种是蓝白瓷. it has beautiful blue patterns painted on a white background, often showing flowers, rivers, or dragons. 它有绘于白色背景的美丽蓝色图案,经常展示花卉,河流,或龙. chinese porcelain traveled to other countries along the silk road, both by land and by sea. 中国瓷器沿丝绸之路陆路和海上游历其他国家. people in europe and themiddle east loved it very much. 欧洲和中东的人们非常喜欢它。 they called it ‘china' because it came from china. 他们称它为"china",因为它来自中国. even today, in english, the word ‘china’ means both the country and fine porcelain. 即使在今天,英语中,“china”一词既指国家,也指精良的瓷器。 chinese porcelain is not just a useful object — it is a piece of art and history. 中国的瓷器不仅仅是一件有用的物品——它是一件艺术和历史的作品. it shows the wisdom and creativity of the chinese people, and it is still loved by people all around the world. 它展现了中国人民的智慧和创造力,它仍然受到全世界人民的喜爱.
re-d035-8bj: 用英文讲好中国故事 what are the chinese zodiac signs? re-d035-8bj read and learn 十二生肖 what are the chinese zodiac signs? 中国黄道标志是什么? the chinese zodiac has twelve animals. 中国黄道十二种动物. they are rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog, and pig. 它们是:老鼠、牛、虎、兔子、龙、蛇、马、山羊、猴子、蟑螂、狗和猪。 each year has one animal. 每年有一只动物。 your birth year gives you that animal. 你出生的一年让你有这种动物。 why are the animals in this order? 为什么动物要这样排列? there is an old story. 有个老故事 the jade emperor held a race across a river. 玉帝驾车过江. the rat rode on the ox and jumped off first. 老鼠骑着牛,先跳下去. so the rat is first, and theoxis second. 故鼠为先,奥克西为次. theother animals came one by one. 其他的动物一个接一个地来了 your zodiac animal is very important in chinese culture. 你的黄道动物在中国文化中非常重要. people say it can show your character. 人们说它可以显示你的性格。 for example, dragons are strong and brave. 譬如龙王坚固勇猛. rabbits are kind and quiet. 兔儿善和静. many people like to know their animal and its meaning. 很多人都喜欢了解他们的动物及其意义. the zodiac also helps with age and time. 黄道也帮助年龄和时间. it repeats every twelve years. 每十二年重复一次. so people born twelve years apart share the same animal. 所以,人们出生 12年分开 分享相同的动物。 it is a fun way to learn about history and family. 了解历史和家庭是一种有趣的方式。
sec_q9ggb3-d036-j45: 用英文讲好中国故事 chinese paper cutting sec_q9ggb3-d036-j45 read and learn chinese paper cutting chinese paper cutting is a traditional folk art with a history of over 1,500 years. 读学中国剪纸中国是民俗艺术,历史长达1500多年. it started in the han dynasty and became popular during the tang and song dynasties. 始于汉朝,在唐,宋两朝时期流行. people use scissors or knives to cut paper into beautiful patterns. 人们使用剪刀或刀将纸张切成美丽的图案. to make a paper cutting, you first fold the red paper. 为了剪纸,你先把红纸叠起来 then you draw a simple design on it. 然后你在上面画了一个简单的设计. after that, you carefully cut along the lines. 在那之后,你小心地切线。 when you open the paper, a wonderful picture appears. 当你打开报纸时, 出现了一幅很棒的照片。 red is the most common color because it means happiness and good luck in china. 红色是最常见的颜色,因为它意味着幸福和好运在中国. the patterns often come from nature and daily life. 这些模式往往来自自然和日常生活。 you can see flowers, birds, fish, and chinese characters like "福" (good fortune). 可以看到花,鸟,鱼,以及"wo"(好运气)等中国人物. animals like dragons and phoenixes stand for power and peace. 龙凤等动物代表力量与和平. many people put paper cuttings on windows, doors, and walls during the spring festival. 许多人在春节期间在窗户,门和墙上都贴上剪纸的纸. they believe the art brings joy and drives away bad luck. 他们相信艺术能带来欢乐 并驱赶厄运 today, paper cutting is not only a hobby for old people. 今天,剪纸不仅是老人的爱好. children and young people also love it. 儿童和青年人也喜欢它。 it is a great way to show chinese culture and make our lives more colorful. 这是展示中国文化,使我们的生活更加多彩的伟大方法.
re-d037-v5g: 用英文讲好中国故事 du fu: the poet who cared for the people re-d037-v5g read and learn du fu: the poet who cared for thepeople 堂草甫杜 du fu is one of the greatest poets of the tang dynasty, often called the "sage of poetry." he lived about 1,300 years ago, around the same time as li bai. 读书学杜甫:"爱民的诗人 but while li bai wrote about romance, nature, and the moon, du fu wrote about real life, the suffering of ordinary people, and his deep love for his country. 但是,虽然李白写了浪漫,自然,月亮,但杜甫却写了真实的生活,普通人的痛苦,以及他对祖国的深情. the two poets were good friends. 两位诗人都是好友. du fu lived during a time of war and chaos in china. 杜甫在中国战乱时期生活. he saw people losing their homes, going hungry, and suffering in the cold. 他看见人们失去家园,挨饿,在寒冷中受苦. his poems reflect this sadness and 下筝如有神杜甫 读书破罗卷 his wish for a better world. 他的诗反映了这种悲哀 和他对于更美好世界的愿望。 one of his most famous poems is "spring view," which describes a city destroyed by war but with flowers still growing in the ruins. 他最著名的诗作之一是"春景",其中描述了一座被战争摧毁但废墟中仍然种植着鲜花的城市. it shows both hope and heartbreak. 既显示希望又让人心碎. du fu's poems are called "poetic history" because they record real events of his time. 杜甫的诗歌被称为"诗史",因为诗歌记录了他当时的真实事件. he wrote about his family, his travels, his poverty, and his dreams. 他写了家事,旅行,贫穷,梦境. unlike li bai's carefree style, du fu's poems are deep, serious, and full of emotion. 与李白的无忧无虑风格不同,杜甫的诗歌深沉,严肃,充满情感. every word carries weight. 每个字都带有重量. he spent his life thinking about how to make the world better, even when he himself was struggling. 他一生都在思考如何让世界变得更美好,即使他自己也在挣扎. today, du fu is loved by millions of people around the world. 如今,杜甫受到全世界数百万人的爱戴. his cottage in chengdu has become a famous museum. 其在成都的小屋成为著名的博物馆. people visit to feel closer to this great poet who taught us to care about others, even in hard times. 人们来此是为了更接近这位伟大的诗人,他教我们关心他人,即使在困难时期. du fu shows us that poetry can be a powerful way to speak for the voiceless and remember what truly matters. 杜甫向我们展示,诗歌可以成为为无声者说话的有力方式,记住真正重要的.
sec_q9ggb3-d038-x4n: 用英文讲好中国故事 li bai: the romantic poet of china sec_q9ggb3-d038-x4n read and learn 疑是地上霜 床前明月光 li bai:the romantic poet of china li bai is one of the greatest poets in chinese history. 读与学 ⁇ 李白:中国浪漫诗人 李白是中国历史上最伟大的诗人之一. he lived during the tang dynasty, about 1,300 years ago. 唐朝时期居住,约前1300年. people call him the "poet immortal" because his poems are so beautiful and full of imagination. 人们称他为"诗不朽",因为他的诗歌如此美丽,充满想象力. even today, almost everychinese child can recite some of his famous lines. 即使在今天,几乎每个中国孩子都可以背诵他的一些著名台词. he wrote over 1,0o0 poems in his lifetime. 他一生写了超过10o0首诗. li bai's poems are known for their love of nature, freedom, and friendship. 李白的诗歌以热爱自然,自由,友谊著称. one of his most famous poems is "thoughts on a quiet night," which begins: "before my bed, the moonlight is bright. 他最著名的一首诗是"静夜的思念",开头是:"在我床前,月光明亮. i think it is frost upon the ground." this short poem about homesickness is loved by chinese people all over the world. 我认为是地面上的霜",这首关于思乡的短诗受到全世界中国人民的喜爱. another famous poem, "drinking alone under the moon," shows his romantic and free spirit. 另一首著名的诗"月下独饮"展现了他浪漫自由的精神. li bai lived an adventurous life. 李白过着冒险的生活. he traveled all over china, visiting mountains, rivers, and famous places. 他游历中国各地,游历山河,名胜胜地. he loved wine and often wrote poems while drinking. 他喜爱葡萄酒,经常在喝酒时写诗. it is said that he could write a beautiful poem in just a few minutes. 据说他在几分钟内就能写出一首美丽的诗. he even met the emperor and became a palace poet for a time, but he preferred a free life of travel and writing. 他甚至遇见了皇帝,并成为了一段时间的宫廷诗人,但他更喜欢旅行和写作的自由生活. li bai's poems teach us to see the beauty in the world and follow our hearts. 李白的诗歌教我们看清天下美人,跟着我们的心. his words have been translated into many languages and are read by people everywhere. 他的言语被翻译成多种语言,各地的人都会阅读. he is not just a chinese treasure — he belongs to the whole world. 他不仅仅是中国的宝藏——他属于整个世界。 as long as people read poetry, li bai's spirit will live on. 只要人们读诗歌,李白的灵性就会继续活下去.

sec_q9ggb3-d040-sx8: 用英文讲好中国故事 the silk road: a bridge between east and west sec_q9ggb3-d040-sx8 read and learn the silk road: abridgebetweeneastandwest the silk road was not just one road —it was a network of trade routes connecting china to the west. 阅读和学习丝绸之路:abridgebetween东西方的丝绸之路不仅仅是一条道路——它是连接中国和西方的贸易路线网. it started over 2,000 years ago during the han dynasty. 始建于汉朝时期,距今2000多年. the road stretched from chang'an (today's xi'an) all theway torome and otherplaces ineurope. 这条路从长安(今天的西安)一直延伸到罗马和欧洲其他地方. itwas one of the longest and most important trade routes in history. 它是历史上最长和最重要的贸易路线之一. why was it called thesilkroad? 为什么叫"西尔克之路"? because silk was the most famous product that traveled from china to the west. 因为丝绸是从中国到西方旅行的最著名的产品. chinese silk was soft, light, and beautiful. 中国丝绸柔软,轻巧,美丽. people in rome and other countries loved it and paid a lot of gold for it. 罗马和其他国家的人们都很喜欢它,为此付出了大量的黄金. but silk was not the only thing. 但丝绸不是唯一的东西。 chinese traders also sent tea, porcelain, paper, and spices. 中国商人也派茶,瓷,纸,和香料来. in return, china got glass, wool, grapes, and chang'an new ideas from the west. 作为回报,中国有玻璃,羊毛,葡萄,以及来自西方的长安新思想. (xi'an) the silk road was not just about goods. sec_q9ggb3-d041-ke4: 用英文讲好中国故事 the chinese knot: tying luck and beauty together sec_q9ggb3-d041-ke4 read and learn 衣首 the chinese knot: 芙吉 tying luck and beauty together the chinese knot is a beautiful handmade decoration made from a single piece of red cord. 阅读与学习 qq 中文小结:qq 捆绑运气与美人合在一起 中文结是一个用单片红线制作的漂亮的手工装饰. it has a history of over 1,000 years. 其历史年代为1000多年. in ancient times, people used knots to record events before writing was invented. 在古代,人们在写作被发明之前就用结来记录事件. later, knots became decorations and symbols of good luck. 后来,结成为装饰和好运的象征. today, the chinese knot is one of the most loved traditional crafts in china. 如今,中国结是中国最受喜爱的传统工艺品之一. a chinese knot is always made from one continuous cord, with no beginning and no end. 中国的结总是用一条连续的绳索来制成的,没有起点,也没有终点. this represents the idea of "never-ending' endless happiness, endless love, and endless good fortune. 这代表了"永不结束"无尽的幸福,无尽的爱,无尽的好运气"的理念. the knot is usually red, because red means happiness and good luck in chinese culture. 结通常为红色,因为红色在中国文化中意味着幸福和好运. sometimes people add small bells, jade, or coins to the knot to make it even more special. 有时人们会在结上加入小铃,玉,或硬币,使其更加特别. there are many different types of chinese knots. 中国结有很多不同的种类. the most common one is the "double coin knot," which looks like two old chinese coins and stands for wealth. 最常见的是"双钱币结",它看起来像两枚中国老钱币,代表着财富. there is also the "button knot," the "cross knot," and the"pan chang knot."each pattern has its own meaning and beauty. 还有"扣结","横结","潘昌结",每一种图案都有其本意和美感. making a chinese knot takes patience and skill, but the result is always wonderful. 做一个中国结需要耐心和技巧,但结果总是很好. during chinese newyear and other festivals, you can see chinese knots hanging in homes, shops, and streets. 在中国新年等节日期间,可以看到中国结在家中,商店和街道上悬挂. people also give chinese knots as gifts to family and friends. 人们也给中国结作为礼物送给亲友. a chinese knot is more than a decoration —- it carries wishes for health, happiness, and a bright future. 中国结不仅仅是装饰——它带有对健康,幸福,以及光明未来的愿望.

sec_cq94j8-d138-z5g: xin概念 lesson 90 what's for supper? sec_cq94j8-d138-z5g lesson90★ what's for supper? 油煎土豆片油煎鱼加炸土豆片一直是英国人喜爱的一道菜，过度捕捞但是随着海洋里的滥捕滥捞，鱼已经变得越来越巨大的昂贵。 90 晚餐吃什么？ what kind of fish are they? 90,它们是什么鱼? fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in britain, but as the oceans have been overfished, fish has become more and more expensive. 因此，听说北海石油钻井平台上的潜水员吓，使恐怖受到巨型鱼类的恐吓，确实很让人吃惊。 so it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on north sea oil rigs. 钻井平潜水员台需要经常修理，潜水员常常要在水面100英尺石油钻塔以下摸黑工作，他们曾在工作时被撞到他们身上的大鱼吓得惊慌失措。 oil rigs have to be repaired frequently and divers, who often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water, have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish bumping into them as they work. 现在他们有了特制的笼子，（复数）理智，头脑用来保护他们免受大鱼的侵袭。 now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters. 这些鱼并不是鲨鱼或逆戟鲸，而是深受人们喜爱的食用鱼品种，鲨鱼如鳕鱼和鳕鱼，只不过它们长得出奇地大，有时长达12英尺。 the fish are not sharks orkillerwhales, butfavouriteeating varieties like cod and skate which grow to unnatural sizes, sometimes as much as twelve feet in length. 这些鱼能长得这么大是由3个因素品种造成的：海底热的输油管道附近的温暖的海水；钻井平台工作人员抛到海里充足的食物；钻井平台周围根本没有捕鱼船只。 three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea; the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs; the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs. 结果是，这些鱼就在因素可爱的温暖的水流中吃呀吃，长呀长。 as a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow in the lovely warm water. 究竟谁吃全体工作人员谁呢？ who eats who? 谁吃谁? new words and expressions 生词和短语 新词和表达式 qq

sec_cq94j8-d001-f6g: xin概念 lesson 1 a puma at large sec_cq94j8-d001-f6g apumaatlarge 逃遁的美洲狮 pumas are large, cat-like animals which are found in america. 普马斯是大型的,类似猫的动物,它们在美国被发现. when reports came into london zoo that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of london, they were not taken seriously. 当报道传到伦敦动物园时,在伦敦以南45英里处发现了一只野生美洲狮,但并没有受到重视. however, as the evidence began to accumulate, experts from the zoo felt obliged to investigate, for the descriptions given by people who claimed to have seen the puma were extraordinarily similar. 然而,随着证据的逐渐积累,动物园的专家感到有义务进行调查,因为声称看到美洲狮的人所作的描述非常相似。 the hunt for the puma began in a small village where a woman pickingblackberriessaw'a largecat'only fiveyards awayfromher. 猎杀美洲狮开始于一个小村庄 一个女人在小村庄里 挑黑莓锯'一只大猫' 离她只有五码远。 it immediately ran away when she saw it, and experts confirmed that a puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered. 它在她看到它时立即逃走,专家们确认,除非被包围,否则美洲狮不会攻击人. the search proved difficult, for the puma was often observed at one place in the morning and at another place twenty miles away in the ___. 事实证明,寻找是困难的,因为美洲狮经常在早晨的一处和20英里外的另一处被观察到. evening. 边 wherever it went, it left behind it a trail of dead deer and small animals like rabbits. 无论它走到哪里,它都留下了一条死鹿和兔子等小动物的踪迹. paw prints were seen in a number of places and puma fur was found clinging to bushes. 在一些地方看到毛印,发现毛皮粘在灌木丛上。 several people complained of 'cat-like noises' at night and a businessman on a fishing trip saw the ___. 数人抱怨夜里有"猫般的噪音",一名商人在钓鱼之旅中看见了 ⁇ . puma up a tree. 美洲马上树. the experts were now fully convinced that the animal was a puma, but where had it come from?
